criterion_6_domain_gap_rigor_hces_asi.finding: BM-CASE-022 (HCES) and BM-CASE-023 (ASI) are not auto-labeled as domain gaps. Guidance explicitly notes potential overlap with KCM-FUNC-11 (Data Analytics) and flags them for NSSTA faculty adjudication.
